purpose: Controlled evidence for position, simulated height, distance, and lighting effects while looking at the webcam lens

action_plan.name: Empty camera view
action_plan.instruction: Remain completely outside the camera view

action_plan.name: Baseline centre
action_plan.instruction: Sit normally and keep looking directly at the lens

action_plan.name: Body left
action_plan.instruction: Move your body left; keep looking at the lens

action_plan.name: Body right
action_plan.instruction: Move your body right; keep looking at the lens

action_plan.name: Face higher
action_plan.instruction: Raise your sitting position; keep looking at the lens

action_plan.name: Face lower
action_plan.instruction: Lower your sitting position; keep looking at the lens

action_plan.name: Near camera
action_plan.instruction: Move closer without covering the face; look at lens

action_plan.name: Far from camera
action_plan.instruction: Move farther away; keep looking at the lens

action_plan.name: Darker face lighting
action_plan.instruction: Reduce room light; normal position; look at lens

action_plan.name: Brighter face lighting
action_plan.instruction: Increase or restore light; normal position; look at lens

note: Height, distance, and lighting labels are controlled categories; they are not physical measurements.
